title: Rotor Work on Warranted Axles: Resurfacing, Replacement and Rotor Coverage
content:
**Clause.** Rotor work on an axle covered by Brake Service Warranties follows the inspection finding, and each rotor is either resurfaced or replaced.

(a) A rotor measured below its OEM minimum thickness is replaced, never resurfaced, under the line's rotor discard rule.

(b) Rotors installed or resurfaced on the original job carry the line's rotor warranty months, from the date of the job, against warping and cracking. Within that period a vibration finding is resurfaced free when the line makes resurfacing for vibration within the rotor warranty free, and a cracked rotor is replaced free.

(c) Outside that period, or on a line whose rotor warranty months are 0, rotor work is charged at the line's price to resurface one rotor or its price for one new rotor installed, per rotor.

(d) Rotors worn below minimum by normal wear are never covered.

**Finding and result, rotor by rotor.**

| Inspection finding on the rotor | Within the rotor warranty of a line with rotor warranty months above 0 | Outside the rotor warranty, or on a line with 0 rotor warranty months |
|---|---|---|
| vibration | resurfaced free where the line makes resurfacing for vibration within the rotor warranty free | charged at the resurfacing price per rotor |
| cracked | replaced free | charged at the new-rotor price per rotor |
| below the OEM minimum thickness | replaced, never resurfaced | replaced, never resurfaced; charged at the new-rotor price per rotor |
| below minimum from normal wear | never covered | never covered |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A line with an illustrative rotor warranty of 8 months: rotors installed on a job on the 1st of a month. Five months later, a cracked rotor found at inspection is replaced free. Ten months after the job, the same finding falls outside the rotor warranty and the new rotor is charged at the line's price for one new rotor installed.
